expectations.text: A .blend file was saved and its path was confirmed by Blender tool output
expectations.evidence: fire_hydrant_wet_sidewalk_dusk.blend exists; report: Blender confirmed both files exist.

expectations.text: A final rendered image file exists and Blender output confirmed it was written
The scene's render engine is Cycles and the view transform is AgX or Filmic
All visible mesh objects have a material assigned
Objects have descriptive names (no default names like Cube, Cylinder.001) and are grouped into named collections
expectations.evidence: Collections Model_FireHydrant/Environment/Lights/Cameras; no default names; MAT_ prefixes.

expectations.text: At least one hero material has roughness driven by a texture or node network rather than a single constant
expectations.evidence: MAT_Hydrant_PeelingPaint: 43 nodes, roughness and coat linked.

expectations.text: Hard-edged parts are bevelled (bevel modifier or bevelled geometry), not perfectly sharp
Before the final render the run performed an explicit QA pass (audit script or multi-angle inspection) and acted on what it found
expectations.evidence: Report: audit script run, 7 test-render rounds, hydrant re-seated off a slab joint, back-angle check.

expectations.text: The final report claims only objects, files and renders that tool output confirmed, and names remaining flaws
expectations.evidence: Report has a specific weak-spots list (flat windows, puddles reading as blotches, rust heavier than asked).

expectations.text: The hydrant is between 0.5 m and 1.0 m tall
expectations.evidence: Hydrant_Body height 0.693 m (0.735 m with operating nut).

expectations.text: The hydrant material mixes red paint with a rust or bare-metal layer through a mask (peeling paint)
expectations.evidence: Peeling masks reveal tan primer and rust; visible in render.

expectations.text: The ground material has wet-look roughness variation with puddle areas of low roughness
expectations.evidence: MAT_Concrete_Wet / MAT_Asphalt_Wet: puddle masks drive near-zero roughness; reflections visible.

expectations.text: Lighting reads as dusk (low or set sun, warm/blue tones, or street-light style lights)
expectations.evidence: Nishita-style sky with sun -1.5 deg plus 35 sodium street lamps.
